findings.claim: onsemi 10-K 揭露：樂山（中國，持股80%）組裝測試廠可能因美中緊張面臨成本增加或貿易限制；商務部實體清單擴大可能要求對中國客戶申請額外出口許可，且不保證取得；進口零組件關稅可能衝擊獲利。
findings.excerpt: our assembly and test operations facility located in Leshan, China, which is owned by Leshan-Phoenix Semiconductor Company Limited, a joint venture company in which we own 80% of the outstanding equity interests, may be subjected to increased costs or additional trade restrictions stemming from the geopolitical tension between the United States and China.

findings.claim: onsemi 10-K 稱 FY2025 貿易法規遵循成本不重大，預期現行法規成本不會有重大不利影響，但未來政策變動可能造成重大成本。
findings.excerpt: The costs we incurred in complying with applicable trade regulations for the year ended December 31, 2025 were not material, and we do not currently expect the cost of complying with existing trade laws and regulations to have a material adverse effect on our capital expenditures or earnings or on our competitive position in any one year.

findings.claim: 2026-01-14 總統公告依 Section 232 對符合特定技術門檻的先進半導體課 25% 關稅，範圍狹窄；搜尋結果未見針對 onsemi 的專屬說明。
findings.source: White & Case: President Trump orders narrowly targeted 25% Section 232 tariff on certain advanced semiconductor articles
